name: Tsingtao Brewery Group Co., Ltd. (青岛啤酒集团有限公司, 青啤集团)
via: sole shareholder and actual controller is the Qingdao Municipal SASAC, per Tsingtao Brewery's 2025 annual report
note: State holding company; the controlling shareholder of the listed Tsingtao Brewery Co., Ltd. with 32.51% (2025 annual report, top-shareholder table). In March 2025 Qingdao SASAC confirmed a strategic merger bringing Qingdao Beverage Group under it.
